result.Method of Attack: Launches Windows info-stealer upon install via postinstall script; Steals browser cookies, local storage, and saved auto-fill form data; Exfiltrates Telegram app files and hijacks sessions for Instagram, Reddit, Spotify, TikTok; Steals crypto wallet data from MetaMask, Exodus, Coinbase, BinanceChain, and others; Exfiltrates data via WebHook to bladeroid[.]xyz domain
result.Impacted Systems: Windows systems; Browsers: Chrome, Brave, Edge, Firefox, Opera, Yandex; Applications: Discord, Telegram, FileZilla; Crypto wallet browser extensions: MetaMask, BinanceChain, Coinbase, Exodus
result.Attack Vector: Malicious npm packages installed by developers; Postinstall script executing encrypted payload in NodeJS
result.Indicators of Compromise: Packages published on npm registry on February 28, 2024; Encrypted payload file 'gayy.js' with embedded decryption key; Webhook URL hosted on bladeroid[.]xyz domain; Turkish language comments and error messages; Domains bladeroid[.]xyz and bladeroid[.]com registered with Turkish provider Turkticaret; References to Bladeroid stealer in code; Package names: deuplouded, snipersee, sniperser, sniperv1, sniperv2
